fixtures.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: synthetic clinician-note image fixture for PsyRec handwriting transcription evaluation.
Create one realistic flat, top-down view of a single off-white sheet, fully visible, with neat blue ballpoint HAND PRINTING (natural handwritten letters, not a computer font). Large readable handwriting, generous line spacing, neutral even lighting, no hands or objects. Portrait page. All text must be verbatim, each sentence on its own line:
"SYNTHETIC TRAINING NOTE
NOT A REAL PATIENT
Case: SYN-HW-001
The client reports poor sleep for three nights.
Mood was described as tired.
No diagnosis is recorded.
Follow-up: review the sleep log."
The first two lines must be especially clear. Fictional educational material only. Do not add a name, date, signature, clinic, diagnosis, medication, extra text or watermark. Keep the full page uncropped and all ink legible.
